Pet care (feeding/cleaning) is a daily routine. The Tuesday midday meal (Day 2) is now clearly an outlier or specific work-from-home instance, but the dominant pattern is a standard commute with weekend home presence.

The Tuesday midday meal (Day 2) suggests potential WFH, but no other weekdays show sustained home presence or laptop/desk evidence. Lack of consistent midday home presence on other weekdays weakens this. If true, hybrid days are rare and unpredictable.
Contradicted by pet items and meal evidence. No new evidence supports this.
